name: paper-distill
description: Human-approved academic knowledge base with arXiv capture, local-first Zotero handoff, and Obsidian wiki compilation

interface.shortDescription: Discover, capture, and compile research papers into an Obsidian knowledge base.
interface.longDescription: Paper Distill stages candidate papers for human approval, captures arXiv-backed source material, produces CRGP-DNL reading notes, and compiles an evidence-backed research wiki.
defaultPrompt: Discover new VLA papers and stage them in my inbox.
Process my approved papers into raw source notes.
Compile my approved notes into wiki concept pages.
